title: Reductions Held Against the Equipment Rental and Demo Packages
content:
## Schedule of reductions, Equipment Rental and Demo

Four reduction figures are held against each package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line: the percentage taken off the rate where the reservation is recorded early enough, the number of calendar days before the collection date at which that early-booking reduction becomes available, the percentage taken off for a rider shown on the collective's records as a season passholder, and the two bundle percentages, one for a package booked alongside a snowsports school booking and one for a package booked alongside collective lodging.

| Package | Advance booking reduction | Advance period, calendar days | Passholder reduction | Lesson bundle reduction | Lodging bundle reduction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 15 per cent | 7 | 10 per cent | 15 per cent | 10 per cent |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 15 per cent | 7 | 15 per cent | 15 per cent | 10 per cent |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 12.5 per cent | 7 | 20 per cent | 10 per cent | 10 per cent |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 10 per cent | 10 | 20 per cent | 10 per cent | 5 per cent |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 10 per cent | 10 | 25 per cent | 0 per cent | 5 per cent |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 0 per cent | 30 | 30 per cent | 0 per cent | 0 per cent |

### The columns defined

1. **Advance booking reduction.** The percentage taken off the rate where the reservation is recorded at least the advance period before the collection date.
2. **Advance period.** The number of calendar days before the collection date at which the advance booking reduction becomes available.
3. **Passholder reduction.** The percentage taken off the package for a rider shown on the collective's records as a season passholder.
4. **Lesson bundle reduction.** The percentage taken off the package when it is booked alongside a snowsports school booking.
5. **Lodging bundle reduction.** The percentage taken off the package when it is booked alongside collective lodging.

### How the figures sit against one another

The passholder figure climbs up the line, from 10 per cent on the Junior Ski & Board Rental to 30 per cent on the Season-Long Lease Package, never falling from one package to the next although the Sport and Performance packages share a figure of 20 per cent, while the two bundle figures fall away: the lesson bundle figure stands at 15 per cent on the Junior and Basic packages, 10 per cent on the Sport and Performance packages, and 0 per cent on the Demo Ski & Board Rental and the Season-Long Lease Package; the lodging bundle figure stands at 10 per cent on the Junior, Basic and Sport packages, 5 per cent on the Performance and Demo packages, and 0 per cent on the Season-Long Lease Package.

The Season-Long Lease Package holds an advance period of 30 calendar days against an advance booking reduction of 0 per cent; the Performance and Demo packages hold a period of 10 calendar days, and the Junior, Basic and Sport packages a period of 7 calendar days. The Sport Ski & Board Rental is the one package of the line whose advance booking figure is not a whole percentage: it stands at 12.5 per cent.
